_comment: Kino (/kino): the films shown in the cinema, in showing order. Each film plays from its 'stream' (protected HLS on Cloudflare R2, made by scripts/kino/encode.mjs and uploaded by scripts/kino/upload.mjs) when it has one, otherwise from 'youtubeId'. 'seconds' is the film's length; 'project' links its project page. Text fields have a Chinese twin (titleZh, noteZh). How to add a film: docs/KINO.md.

films.title: Anterior Future
films.note: A look at my mother's family through the 10,000 photographs my grandfather left when he died.
films.noteZh: 透过外公生前留下的一万张老照片，回看我的母系家族。

films.title: Fragmented Ocean
films.note: Installation space. The work as shown in After the Waiting Room.
films.noteZh: 装置空间。作品在“After the Waiting Room”中的现场记录。

films.title: An Entangled Past
films.note: Installation space at RCA 2022: Gestalt Lost in Time (book), An Entangled Past (triptych print) and Fragmented Ocean (installation).
films.noteZh: RCA 2022 的装置空间：《迷失于时间的格式塔》（书）、《纠缠的过往》（三联版画）和《破碎的海洋》（装置）。
